title: 阿里山國家森林遊樂區 > 觀光景點 > 交通部觀光署
description:
Alishan Forest Railway Train

A bright red narrow-gauge train winds its way through the dense cedar forests of Taiwan’s Alishan National Forest Recreation Area. The vintage carriages, painted in red and white, stand out against the lush greenery and towering trees. Alongside the tracks, a moss-covered stone wall and wooden railing guide the path, enhancing the historic atmosphere.

Alishan is famed for its forest railway, built during the Japanese colonial era to transport timber. Today, it offers visitors a tranquil ride through ancient woods, misty valleys, and scenic mountain landscapes. The legend of Chief Abali, who first hunted in these forests over 250 years ago, lends cultural depth to this natural wonder.
